result.card: This PR cleans up functional tests as a follow-up to PR #35543. It replaces hardcoded extended keys and addresses in wallet_importdescriptors.py with dynamically derived keys via the ExtendedPrivateKey helper. It also unifies how tests avoid default wallet creation by setting self.wallet_names = [] rather than implementing a no-op init_wallet override.
